notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Today comes with the first update of Cathy And The Others !

First, I'd like to thank everyone who played the game ! You guys rocks ! Cathy And The Others is my first video game on Steam and thanks to you, the game is becoming more and more stable ! 

My main objective is to reduce the player's frustration. I don't want you to spend 20 minutes searching for an item or trying to understand why Cathy said this line. 


Patch 1.1 changelog : 

Bugs : 


 Loading screen : Fixed an issue where the diary was loading texts indefinitely and was forcing the player to a force quit. 
 Added new collision detection on some walls.
 Fixed a specific text appearance in the diary.

Gameplay : 

 Changed the location of the note in the fusebox. 
 Updated the note to red color.

Added : 

 New arrows on the last box to push (héhé)


Merci ! 

Kevin
